description: A series of mysterious thefts have left the coastal town of Nice in turmoil. As the sun sets over the Mediterranean, shadows of deceit linger. Your task is to uncover the truth behind the thefts, where every whisper could lead you closer to the elusive thief. Follow the trail through the vibrant streets of Nice, then to the bustling markets of Marseille, and finally to the historic alleys of Genoa. Each city holds secrets, but only one suspect is the mastermind behind it all.
